interpretation.DIRECTIONALLY_PERSISTENT_ONLY: Positive point means in both periods without simultaneous proof.
interpretation.FAILED_OR_UNIDENTIFIABLE: Did not maintain positive point means or lacked enough observations.
interpretation.ROBUST_25BPS_POSTSAMPLE: Strong historical persistence in maintained factor series under strict simultaneous gate and coarse cost sensitivity; still not an executable War Room edge.
interpretation.ROBUST_GROSS_POSTSAMPLE: Strong gross historical persistence but not robust to 25 bps/month sensitivity.
